author: Slidebean
description:
NASA changed the plan mid mission

Orion’s heat shield cracked in 100+ places.

NASA didn’t replace it.
They changed the re-entry instead.

From “skip entry” → to a steeper descent.

Tomorrow’s splashdown will test if it works.

At 25,000 mph, there’s no margin for error.

 👉 For more like this, check out the Slidebean YouTube channel.
title: Why NASA changed the plan

author: Slidebean
description:
Old tech just became relevant again

NASA released 3D images of the Artemis mission.

Most modern devices can’t display them properly.

But a Nintendo 3DS can, no glasses needed.

Sometimes old hardware isn’t obsolete.
It’s just waiting for the right use case.

👉 Watch more on the Slidebean YouTube channel.
title: The comeback of a forgotten device
